  • Airspace & travel: Regional airports closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight scans show ~338–351 commercial aircraft; scans report 0 military aircraft detected.
  • Domestic politics: Elections Committee ordered removal of a Netanyahu campaign video pending final ruling.
  • Northern border / Hezbollah: Daily exchanges continue on the northern front. Expect intermittent rocket/missile fire and Israeli responses.
  • Straits of Hormuz: Iran allows passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China) while selectively blocking others.
  • Intelligence note: No new confirmed strikes inside Israel in the last two hours. Civilian risk remains high near border zones and key ports.
  • 🟢 Good News: Indirect talks reported as progressing. US pause on energy strikes may reduce immediate risk to energy infrastructure.

Threat assessment: Volatile — risk of escalation.

  • גבול צפון / חיזבאללה: חילופי אש יומיומיים נמשכים. צפו לשיגורי רקטות/טילים ומענה ישראלי נקודתי.
  • מיצרי הורמוז: איראן מאפשרת מעבר למדינות ידידותיות (רוסיה, הודו, סין) וחוסמת אחרות באופן סלקטיבי.
  • הערת מודיעין: בשעתיים האחרונות אין דיווחים מאומתים על תקיפות חדשות בתוך ישראל. הסיכון לאזרחים גבוה באזורים גבוליים ונמלים.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: דו"חות על התקדמות בשיחות עקיפות. הפסקת התקיפות על תשתיות אנרגיה עשויה להפחית סיכון מיידי לתשתיות.

הערכת איום: תנודתי — סיכון להחרפה.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Diplomacy / Talks: Trump announced a second 10‑day pause on strikes targeting Iranian energy assets (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET), claiming it was at Iran's request. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Indirect technical talks in Doha reported as "positive progress". Parties agree further negotiations after Khamenei's funeral. Iran says it will open a communication channel on an MoU.
  • Military activity / Airspace: Multiple regional airports closed — Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Civilian flight counts sharply reduced in scans.
  • Flight scans show ongoing military movements (C‑130, RCH series flights detected). Airspace restrictions remain in effect.
  • Northern border / Gaza: Hezbollah activity continues daily on the northern front. In Gaza, reports of three Palestinians killed despite a declared ceasefire.
  • Maritime / Hormuz: Iran is allowing passage for select friendly states (Russia, India, China) while blocking others. Shipping risk remains elevated.
  • Context: First 5‑day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — tactical note: pauses have been fragile and reversible.
  • Strategic / Political: US and Israel signed a land agreement / $1 lease for a permanent US embassy complex in West Jerusalem.
  • International posture: Reports (TASS) that the US may resume military action if talks fail. No major troop deployments publicly reported in the last 6 hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: Indirect technical talks continue; both sides report progress aimed at a ceasefire and resuming shipments.

Bottom line: Escalating — diplomatic progress reduces some immediate economic attack risk, but pauses are fragile and military pressure continues.

  • Northern Border — Hezbollah: Daily rocket/missile harassment and targeted strikes persist. Pattern: sustained low-to-medium intensity barrage targeting border communities and IDF positions.
  • Maritime / Strait of Hormuz: Iran allows passage for select “friendly” states (Russia, India, China); restricts others. Commercial shipping risk remains elevated.
  • International actions: US warns it may resume military action if talks fail. US and Israel signed land agreement for permanent US embassy complex in Jerusalem (political development during conflict).
  • Civilian impact: Continued closures and strikes disrupt travel and services. Limited humanitarian outreach continues (Israeli medical/humanitarian teams active abroad).
  • 🟢 Good News: A formal 10-day pause announced and mediators report technical progress in talks. No major new escalatory naval interdictions reported in last 48 hrs.
  • Threat assessment: escalating
